page: Microsoft Azure D2ds_v7 is a general-purpose virtual machine belonging to the Ddsv7 family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6973P-C processor operating at 4.2 GHz, configured with 2 vCPUs derived from a single physical core with hyperthreading. The hardware allocation includes 8.0 GB of system memory, which equates to 4.0 GB per core, a 480 MB L3 cache, and 118 GB of local SSD storage. No GPU resources are included.

Benchmark results indicate a divergence between single-core and multi-core capabilities. Single-core CPU performance is average, as demonstrated by a stress-ng single-core score of 2268.08 and average single-threaded compression speeds. However, multi-core performance is poor, placing in the bottom 10% with a stress-ng multi-core score of 2300.17 due to the single physical core limitation. Memory performance is also constrained, with uncached read and write bandwidths falling into the weak and poor categories respectively.

The D2ds_v7 offers a low-capacity hardware profile with dedicated CPU allocation and local storage, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads that do not require high parallel processing power or massive memory throughput. It is suited for light web serving, basic single-threaded processing, development environments, and small-scale database operations.
